name: Osari Hikaru
source:
A mood maker with a cheerful and service-minded spirit. He leads the group with his energetic performance, but sometimes pushes himself too far without realizing it. 

He has a problem that he doesn't show his fans.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#osarihikaru]official website[/url]]
